standard.summary: loss 在多少次连续评估窗口内没有改善就触发早停。默认 5。
standard.effect: patience=5 表示允许连续 5 个评估窗口（每窗口 ac_loss_plateau_window 步）没有改善才停止。
standard.whenToUse: 训练初期 loss 波动大时建议设为 8~10；稳定训练可保持 5。
standard.avoidWhen: 不建议设为 1~2（太容易误触发）。

standard_en.summary: How many consecutive evaluation windows may pass without loss improvement before early stopping fires. Default 5.
standard_en.effect: patience=5 means training stops only after 5 consecutive evaluation windows -- each ac_loss_plateau_window steps long -- show no improvement.
standard_en.whenToUse: When the loss swings a lot early on, 8 to 10 is safer; a stable run can keep 5.
standard_en.avoidWhen: Do not set it to 1 or 2 -- far too easy to trigger by accident.

advanced.principle: 统计连续未改善评估次数，超过 patience 触发。每次 loss 有改善时计数器归零。
advanced.tradeoffs: 与 loss_plateau_window 乘积决定总容忍步数：patience=5, window=50 → 250 步无改善才停止。

advanced_en.principle: Counts consecutive evaluations without improvement; triggers when the count exceeds patience. The counter resets whenever loss improves.
advanced_en.tradeoffs: Multiplied by loss_plateau_window it determines total tolerance: patience=5, window=50 → stop only after 250 steps without improvement.
